verdict.rationale: Paxos is an API-driven stablecoin and crypto infrastructure platform, so operating it through natural language is a fair axis. The pack shows no way to run platform actions this way: no conversational agent, MCP server, or NL command interface. The AI assistance it does mention is limited to contextual help inside the documentation and llms.txt / llms-full.txt files that let AI tools index the docs, which helps developers build integrations but does not operate the product.
